bocha_web.summary: 文档列表 文档介绍 It is now almost 50 years since the publication of Robert H. MacArthur and Edward O. Wilson’s 1963 paper, An Equilibrium Theory of Insular Zo ‐ ogeography which led to their famous book, The Theory of Island Biogeography (MacArthur and Wilson 1967).
